title: Edit: Losing my interest
text:
EDIT: changed to 3 stars. After three boxes each one had the two pops, the t-shirt, and a decal/sticker and pin. I didn’t mind the decals and pins at first but was expecting some variety after three boxes. I’ll stick around for January’s box, but if it’s a decal and pin again I’m done.

ORIGINAL: As a huge X-Men fan I subscribed to get the box. I love the t-shirt, the pin is great and the decal is one of my favorite characters! I expected to get some version of wolverine and was pretty disappointed getting Mystique transforming into wolverine as well. The box was overall good enough for me to stay subscribed for Marvel Zombies next though.
label: neutral
